EmailTemplate.name: ITA - FAQ New Request Button Missing
EmailTemplate.subject: ITA - FAQ New Request Button Missing
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName}
Thank you for contacting Insperity Time & Attendance Support. When an employee's New Request button is missing it is usually due to one of two things.
They do not have a supervisor assigned to them.
With no supervisor assigned, the request has nowhere to go, so the system won't allow them.
Once you assign a supervisor to the employee, and they log out and back in, the New Request button should appear for them. (Primary supervisor assignments should be managed in Premier.)
The employee's start/effective date is after the period that is current in your system.
In this case, the employee's profile doesn't exist in the period in which they're viewing the Requests page, so it won't allow them to add new requests.
Once you've moved the pay period forward, the New Request button will appear for the employee.
Please let us know if you have any further questions and we'll be happy to help!
Thank you,
